name: AI Security Fundamentals: The OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
description: A practitioner course on securing applications that use large language models, organized around the 2026 OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Every risk comes with a hypothetical scenario, the root cause, and concrete defenses in code and configuration.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI Security Fundamentals: The OWASP Top 10 for LLMs

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 18 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 45 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
